newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:
Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said spokesman Jean-Christophe Filori would be available to journalists during the Christmas holidays.

Spokesman Filippo di Robilant briefed on the Fisheries Council. He said agreement had been reached on ship satellite control. He said a decision on the POP4 had been postponed to end of April 1997. He also said the UK proposal for a minimum salmon price did not reached unanimity.

In answer to a question, di Robilant said Denmark had expressed a reserve on the satellite control proposal linked to a national parliament vote that finds satellite control anticonstitutional. Di Robilant said satellites would observe boats and not people's behaviour on their boat.

Spokesman Willy Helin said Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Ciampi had sent a letter to Commissioner Karel Van Miert to say that the Italian authorities would take the necessary measures to let the Commission authorise recapitalisation of Banco di Napoli.

In answer to a question on reports on an exchange of letters between Commission President Jacques Santer and UK Prime Minister John Major on BSE, spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the quotes reported were biased and journalists should consult the letters and not just extracts.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1217: Commission takes legal action to curb nitrate pollution in Spain, Italy, Greece and France.
- IP/96/1219: Commission takes legal action to improve access to environmental information in Germany.
- IP/96/1221: Commission takes legal action over Spain's failure to implement hazardous waste rules.
- IP/96/1222: Commission ends legal case against Belgium concerning a directive on surface water.
- IP/96/1228: Hearing on the IGC and the environment.
- IP/96/1229: Citizens First - large public response.
- IP/96/1230: Single market - infringement procedures for failure to notify national implementing measures.
- IP/96/1232: Commission clears restructuring of Westinghouse and Equipos Nucleares activities.
- IP/96/1233: Commission clears the acquisition of Kautex companies by Textron.
- IP/96/1234: Commission clears the operation by which GKN and Brambles acquire jointly Mabeg.
- IP/96/1235: Commission clears Generali and Prime (Fiat) merger.
- IP/96/1236: Commission approves P&O and Nedlloyd joint venture.
- IP/96/1237: Commission clears joint venture in the telecoms sector in Ireland.
- IP/96/1240: Commission confirms eight infringement procedures against Member States in the transport sector.
- IP/96/1241: Commission approves the takeonver of Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP) by Axa.
- IP/96/1243: Cyprus-Intercommunal contacts.
- Speech/96/338: Speech by Commission President Jacques Santer on the IGC after the Dublin European Council.
- Memo/96/123: Calendar of the European Commission activities from 6 to 11 January, 1997.
- Memo/96/124: EU/Hungary relations.
- Eurostat news release No 83/96: EU industrial production up 0.4%.
- ME96/20.12: Midday Express.
